{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "FULL STATIC WEBSITE PROMPT – HOTEL NEWS / MAGAZINE LANDING PAGE IN VUE

Create a polished static marketing/news website for a fictional boutique hotel brand called “Luma Harbor Hotels”. The site should feel like a mix between a premium hotel homepage and a modern video/news portal inspired by Bilibili layout energy: card-heavy, bright gradients, playful tabs, floating badges, animated hover states, and a strong editorial feed. This is NOT a booking system and NOT a real news app. Use only static/mock content, no API, no backend, no database, no login, no payment, no real-time data.

TECH REQUIREMENT
- Build with Vue, preferably a single-page static site.
- Use local/static sample data arrays for hotel news, offers, stories, and video-style cards.
- The website must run as a static front-end only.
- No external API calls.
- No authentication, no account pages, no admin panel.
- No 3D, no WebGL, no game mechanics.

VISUAL STYLE
Overall style: colorful gradient, premium but friendly, hotel + travel + editorial.
Reference feeling: Bilibili-style content browsing, but redesigned for hotel news and lifestyle marketing.
Colors:
- Main gradient: coral pink → sunset orange → warm gold.
- Secondary gradient: ocean blue → lavender.
- Background: very light warm cream with soft gradient blobs.
- Cards: white / glassmorphism panels with subtle shadows.
- Text: deep navy and charcoal.
- Accent: mint green for freshness and small labels.

MOOD
Fresh, animated, clean, modern, optimistic. It should not look like a boring corporate hotel site. It should feel like guests are browsing a lively hotel lifestyle channel: events, room stories, chef updates, city guides, wellness, seasonal campaigns.

PAGE STRUCTURE

1. TOP NAVIGATION
- Sticky top nav with translucent blur background.
- Logo: “Luma Harbor” with small sparkle or wave icon made in CSS/text, no image required.
- Nav links: Home, Hotel News, Offers, City Guide, Dining, Wellness, Contact.
- Right side button: “Explore Stories”.
- Small animated gradient underline on hover.
- Mobile responsive hamburger menu is okay, but still static front-end.

2. HERO SECTION
Left side:
Small pill badge: “Hotel News • Summer 2026 Edition”
Main headline:
“Stay Inspired With Fresh Stories From Luma Harbor”
Subtext:
“Discover seasonal hotel updates, dining highlights, local guides, wellness rituals, and guest experiences — all in one colorful editorial space.”
CTA buttons:
- “Read Latest News”
- “View Hotel Highlights”
Stats row:
- 24 New Stories
- 8 City Guides
- 5 Seasonal Offers

Right side:
Create a large animated editorial dashboard inspired by a video/news platform layout:
- Main featured card with gradient image placeholder: “Rooftop Sunset Lounge Opens This July”
- Smaller stacked cards: “Chef’s Coastal Menu”, “Weekend Spa Ritual”, “Harbor Walk Guide”
- Floating mini labels: “Trending”, “Editor’s Pick”, “Guest Favorite”
- Use CSS gradient blocks instead of real images.
- Add slow floating animation, soft pulse, and card hover lift.

3. TRENDING NEWS STRIP
Horizontal Bilibili-like scrolling/overflow card row, but static mock content.
Section title: “Trending at the Hotel”
Cards should include:
- “A New Garden Breakfast Experience”
- “Behind the Design of Our Ocean Rooms”
- “Evening Jazz Returns to the Lobby Bar”
- “How Our Concierge Builds Perfect Weekends”
Each card:
- Gradient thumbnail
- Category tag
- Title
- Small metadata text like “3 min read” or “Updated today” but all mock/static.
- Hover animation: lift, glow border, thumbnail gradient shift.

4. FEATURED HOTEL NEWS GRID
This is the main news section.
Layout: large feature card on left, four smaller news cards on right or responsive grid.
Title: “Latest Hotel Stories”
Tabs like Bilibili channel filters:
- All
- Rooms
- Dining
- Events
- Wellness
- City Guide
The tabs can visually switch active state using Vue local state only, but content can be static/sample. No data fetching.
Sample article cards:
- “Inside the New Coral Suite Refresh”
- “Meet the Team Behind the Lobby Floral Wall”
- “Five Morning Rituals for a Calm Stay”
- “Local Markets Worth Visiting Before Noon”
- “Chef Amara’s Summer Tasting Notes”
- “Poolside Cinema Nights Begin Friday”
Each article card should have:
- category label
- title
- short excerpt
- read time
- decorative gradient thumbnail

5. PROMOTIONAL HOTEL CAMPAIGN SECTION
Make a wide gradient banner, very marketing-site style.
Headline:
“Summer Harbor Escape Package”
Subtext:
“Three nights of coastal calm, breakfast on the terrace, welcome drinks, and curated city tips from our local hosts.”
Bullets:
- Terrace breakfast included
- Late checkout subject to availability (mock text)
- Complimentary welcome mocktail
- Digital city guide preview
CTA: “See Package Details”
Add animated gradient wave or floating circles in background.
Important: This is informational only, no booking engine.

6. VIDEO-STYLE STORY WALL
Inspired by Bilibili cards but hotel-themed. Make it feel like a content platform.
Title: “Watch the Hotel Come Alive”
Subtitle: “Static preview cards for editorial video stories — no video player required.”
Cards:
- “60 Seconds in the Rooftop Garden”
- “A Day With Our Pastry Chef”
- “Room Tour: Harbor View Studio”
- “Morning Yoga on the Deck”
- “How We Style a Welcome Tray”
- “City Lights From Level 18”
Each card should look like a video card with:
- gradient thumbnail
- play icon overlay made with CSS
- fake duration label like 02:18
- title and small view-like mock text e.g. “12k views” but clearly just display text
No embedded YouTube, no real video service.

7. EDITORIAL CATEGORIES SECTION
Grid of category tiles:
- Guest Stories
- Dining Notes
- Local Culture
- Spa & Wellness
- Design Journal
- Seasonal Offers
Each tile has icon-like emoji or CSS icon, gradient hover, short description.
Animate on hover.

8. HOTEL HIGHLIGHTS / TRUST SECTION
Create elegant cards:
- “Award-winning coastal interiors”
- “Walkable city-center location”
- “Chef-led seasonal dining”
- “Wellness spaces with harbor views”
Use icons, small descriptions, and soft animated entrance effect.

9. NEWSLETTER / STATIC SIGNUP VISUAL
Section title: “Get the Monthly Stay Letter”
Email input and button for visual only. No actual submission needed.
Add microcopy: “Static demo form — no data is sent.”
Style with gradient border and floating label.

10. FOOTER
Columns:
- Luma Harbor
- Explore
- Stories
- Contact
Include mock address, mock social links, and small disclaimer:
“Static demo website with sample editorial content.”

ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS
- Smooth fade-up sections on load or scroll if easy, otherwise CSS animations are fine.
- Floating hero cards.
- Gradient background movement.
- Hover lift on cards.
- Active tab animation.
- Button shine effect.
- Subtle marquee or horizontal scroll feeling for trending strip, but no complicated behavior.
Keep animations tasteful, not distracting.

RESPONSIVE REQUIREMENTS
- Desktop: polished multi-column layout.
- Tablet: grids collapse nicely.
- Mobile: single-column cards, nav adapts, hero stacks, buttons full width if needed.

CONTENT TONE
Editorial, inviting, slightly premium, not too formal. Use hotel/travel/news language.
Avoid placeholder lorem ipsum. Use realistic mock copy.

DELIVERABLE EXPECTATION
Please implement the full static Vue website with clean component structure if possible. It should look complete without external images by using CSS gradients, shapes, icons, and sample data. Make the design medium complexity: not tiny, but also not an overengineered app. The goal is a beautiful static hotel news marketing site with Bilibili-inspired browsing patterns, gradient visuals, and smooth animations.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
